escena: SCENE (cinematic, a real night photograph in a city plaza, epic scale, inverted scale read in two beats, composed NATIVELY for a SQUARE 1:1 feed ad). THE IDEA, which must read in two seconds: the same campaign works at every scale, a giant facade and a phone in her hand show the same key visual. GEOGRAPHY: the UPPER 42% of the frame is one continuous, evenly dark, starless overcast night sky in deep navy-black with fine grain: no light, no glow, no buildings, no signs and no objects; it is calm from edge to edge. Everything lit lives between 44% and 84% of the frame height. The LOWEST 16% of the frame is the near-black matte edge of a concrete bench right in front of the lens, completely out of focus, outside every light. THE MOMENT: behind her, a MONUMENTAL curved LED facade on a dark building fills the band between 44% and 82% of the frame height and runs past the left edge, showing ONE campaign key visual of a fictitious running-shoe brand: a real photograph of an athlete frozen mid-stride on wet asphalt at dusk, wearing a vivid orange (#FF6500) jacket, shot from a low angle, with a single bold diagonal of orange light; no letters, no logo; the giant athlete is on the LEFT half of the facade, clearly visible. In the foreground, on the RIGHT half of the frame, the creative director, framed CLOSE from the chest up so her face is large and sharp: the top of her head at about 46% of the frame height and her chin at about 64%. She holds up her phone beside her face with her right hand, fully visible: on its screen, the SAME key visual, the same athlete and the same orange diagonal, sharp. Her head is almost frontal and she looks straight into the lens with a calm, knowing half-smile. LIGHT: the facade is the only key light, washing her from behind and the left with warm orange; the phone screen lights her chin and hand from below; NO fill, the far side of her face in shadow with the nose shadow legible. A cool azure (#0375DB) rim outlines her hair. COLOR GRADE exactly like a cinema still: deep navy-black night, the warm orange facade as the only warm light, a cool azure rim. Her skin is natural, exactly as in the casting references: real pores, even healthy tone, her real age, no retouching. She wears the Efeonce hoodie exactly as in its reference. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about one and a half meters away at chest height, 85mm at f/1.8, nothing foreshortened. Real sensor grain, genuine depth of field. No readable text, no letters, no logos of any brand.
